Area Tasks
Context Menu Position
Top
Below Vanilla Tasks
Bottom
Controls where Area Tasks appears in the world right-click menu. Below Vanilla Tasks places it immediately before Sit on ground or Walk to.
Maximum furniture per Disassemble task
Maximum furniture objects selected per task. Default: 10. Range: 0 to 100. Set to 0 to hide and disable Disassemble. Multi-tile furniture counts once and must fit entirely inside the area.
Move Items carry limit
Maximum Carry
Avoid Overburden

Applies to all Move Items routes except Bag destinations. Maximum Carry uses the normal inventory limit. Avoid Overburden uses the character's current unburdened capacity, including existing carried weight, and may require more trips. Items that cannot fit under the limit are left behind.
Maximum Area Width and Height
Maximum width and height, in tiles, of a newly selected task area. Default: 25. Allowed range: 1 to 50.
Maximum Destination Distance
Maximum tile distance from the player when choosing a container/vehicle source or a task destination. Default: 50. Allowed range: 1 to 100.
Plank Behavior
One Plank Per Window
Fully Plank Windows

Choose how Barricade Planks works on each selected window side. One Plank Per Window adds one plank per run. Fully Plank Windows adds planks until each selected side has four. Both applies the behavior to both sides. Existing metal barricades are skipped. Requires available materials and tools.
Time speed during area tasks (single-player)
Normal speed change rules
Maintain speed during job; normal at end
Maintain speed during and after job

Normal rules follows the Accessibility option to resume normal speed when timed actions complete. The other modes prevent speed resets between actions in the same job. Choose whether to return to normal speed when the job ends, including cancellation or failure, or keep the current speed. Manual speed changes, pause, and other game-triggered speed changes still apply. Captured when a job starts. No effect in multiplayer.
